EIP-6466 clarifies the contract_address receipt field
summary_en: etan-status split two EIPs from EIP-7799: EIP-8115 pays priority fees in a batch at the end of the block, and EIP-8116 replaces cumulative receipt fields. fselmo submitted corrections to EIP-7907 contract code metering. The agenda for the off cycle ACDE #227 on January 5 went up.
